Parameter.name: library_path
Parameter.description: definition of the outlets of the watershed loaded from watershed_library.csv file

Parameter.name: from_shp
Parameter.description: Path to the shapefile that will be used as "Watershed". With such an option, Watershed is not generated but loaded from the file

Parameter.name: from_dem
Parameter.description: Uses DEM instead of shapefile True if the process start from a given DEM of xyz file Cases where domain is not georeferenced (e.g. synthetic geometry, erosion models)

Parameter.name: subbasin_path
Parameter.description: generate subbasins from stations or manual points

Parameter.name: cell_size
Parameter.description: specify new resolution from a given DEM or None
